# 00000007831

**MSE-21 ★** — source: 246_模空间与枚举几何II.md

**English.** Definition: The group action Gamma on stable moduli stacks generated by twists along (-1)-spherical objects in chains w_{a_1,...,a_n} of D^b(Coh X). Conjecture: Wall crossing of the Gamma action on the rigidity locus is given solely by spherical twists, and the crossing count is the Carlitz q-Catalan number of the cluster dictionary of the affine A_n lattice; and the count at a dimension-3 flop center is row d of Pascal triangle, d the length of the flop. (spherical wall-crossing q-Catalan counts)

**中文。** 定义：导出范畴的正交群作用：D^b(Coh X) 的直链 w_{a_1,…,a_n} 的由 (−1)-球面的扭转生成的群作用 Γ。猜想：Γ 在稳定模栈上的作用在刚性区域的墙穿越仅由球面扭转给出，穿越次数计数为仿射 A_n 格的 Kluster 字典的 Carlitz q-Catalan 数；且该计数在维度 3 的 flop 中心为杨辉三角的第 d 行（d 为 flop 的长度）。
